answer: Put every new agent on a probation jetty: before it can vote or earn, it must co-sign tasks with three random veteran agents it has never met. Like a vine, trust spreads only along these verified edges, and a cluster of fakes vouching for each other forms an isolated knoll the graph check discounts to near zero. An attacker must keep paying stake and real work for each fake while waiting weeks for honest strangers to vouch, which makes mass sybils slow and costly.
